example_en: day-to-day problems/responsibilities
example_zh: 日常問題／責任

example_en: She made her professional stage debut in Swan Lake.
example_zh: 她在《天鵝湖》中完成了她的首次職業舞臺演出。

example_en: Members of Congress have to make a declaration of their business interests.
example_zh: 議員們必須將自己的商業股權公諸於眾。

chinese_meaning: 奉獻，獻出（全部精力、時間等）
example_en: He has dedicated his life to scientific research.
example_zh: 他把自己的一生都奉獻給科學研究工作。

chinese_meaning: 盡心盡力的，盡職盡責的
example_en: a dedicated father/teacher
example_zh: 盡職盡責的父親／教師

example_en: He has always shown great dedication to the cause.
example_zh: 他對這項事業一直都表現出強烈的奉獻精神。

example_en: All the company's aircraft have been grounded, after a defect in the engine cooling system was discovered.
example_zh: 自從發現發動機冷卻系統有缺陷之後，這家公司所有的飛機都已經停飛了。

example_en: Pregnant women often suffer from iron deficiency.
example_zh: 孕婦常常缺鐵。

example_en: The country is running a balance-of-payments/budget/trade deficit of $250 million.
example_zh: 該國的收支差額／預算赤字／貿易逆差已達2.5億美元。

example_en: Delegates have voted in favour of the motion.
example_zh: 代表們對這項動議投了贊成票。

example_en: This disaster is a clear demonstration of the need for tighter controls.
example_zh: 這場災難清楚表明需要進一步加強控制。

example_en: The area has a high/low population density.
example_zh: 該地區人口密度大／小。

example_en: I'd like you to meet Ann Gregory, my deputy.
example_zh: 我想請你見見我的副手安•葛列格裡。

chinese_meaning: 該機構的資金均來自海外投資。
example_en: The institute derives all its money from foreign investments.
example_zh: 該機構的資金均來自海外投資。

example_en: I desire only to be left in peace.
example_zh: 我只想清清靜靜地不受打擾。

example_en: The destiny of our nation depends on this vote!
example_zh: 我們國家的前途取決於這次選舉！

chinese_meaning: （尤指用特殊方法）發現，察覺，看出
example_en: Some sounds cannot be detected by the human ear.
example_zh: 有些聲音是人的耳朵無法察覺到的。

example_en: She was taken into hospital last week when her condition suddenly deteriorated.
example_zh: 她是在上周病情突然惡化時被送進醫院的。

example_en: The number of staff we can take on will be determined by how much money we're allowed to spend.
example_zh: 我們僱用的人數將取決於可支配資金的多少。

example_en: The UN will dictate the terms of troop withdrawal from the region.
example_zh: 聯合國將決定軍隊從該地區撤軍的條件。

example_en: a diesel engine
example_zh: 柴油引擎

example_en: We do not differentiate between our employees on the basis of their race, religion, or national origin.
example_zh: 我們不會因員工的種族、宗教或原籍國不同而區別對待。

example_en: I find that I don't digest meat easily.
example_zh: 我發現自己不容易消化肉食。

example_en: Discover how eating raw food helps balance your body and aids digestion.
example_zh: 弄清楚為甚麼生吃食物有助於身體的營養平衡並能促進消化。

example_en: I don't want to diminish her achievements, but she did have a lot of help.
example_zh: 我不想貶低她的成就，但她確實得到了很多幫助。

example_en: diplomatic negotiations
example_zh: 外交談判

example_en: a business directory
example_zh: 企業名錄

chinese_meaning: 處於劣勢的，處於不利地位的
example_en: A new educational programme has been set up for economically disadvantaged children.
example_zh: 一個新的面向貧困兒童的教育計劃已經設立。

example_en: Although they said nothing, she could sense their disapproval of her suggestion.
example_zh: 雖然他們甚麼也沒說，但她能感覺到他們並不贊成她的建議。

chinese_meaning: 極其糟糕的；極為失敗的；災難性的
example_en: Such a war would be disastrous for the country.
example_zh: 這樣一場戰爭會給國家帶來災難性的後果。

chinese_meaning: 不適，不安；令人不適（或不安）的事物
example_en: You may feel a little discomfort for a few days after the operation.
example_zh: 在手術後的幾天裡你可能會感到有些不適。

example_en: She felt she had been discriminated against because of her age.
example_zh: 她認為自己受到了年齡歧視。

example_en: racial/sex/age discrimination
example_zh: 種族／性別／年齡歧視

chinese_meaning: 對…不予理會，摒棄，（從頭腦中）去除
example_en: I think he'd dismissed me as an idiot within five minutes of meeting me.
example_zh: 我認爲他和我見面五分鐘後就把我歸入了傻瓜之列。

example_en: unfair/wrongful dismissal
example_zh: 不公正／錯誤的解僱

example_en: There's a distinct smell of cigarettes in here.
example_zh: 這裡確實有一股煙味兒。

chinese_meaning: 與眾不同的，獨特的，特別的
example_en: a distinctive smell/taste
example_zh: 特別的氣味／味道

example_en: She claimed that the way she had been treated at work had caused her extreme emotional and psychological distress.
example_zh: 她說自己在工作中受到的待遇讓她在情感和心理上都感到非常痛苦。

example_en: Has the Channel Tunnel improved the distribution of goods between the British Isles and mainland Europe?
example_zh: 海峽隧道是否改善了不列顛群島與歐洲大陸之間的貨物流通？

example_en: Residents are tired of the disturbance caused by the nightclub.
example_zh: 居民受夠了夜總會造成的干擾。

example_en: Does television adequately reflect the ethnic and cultural diversity of the country?
example_zh: 電視節目能充分反映出這個國家民族和文化的多樣性嗎？

example_en: She treated the business as her private domain.
example_zh: 她把公司看作是自己的私人勢力範圍。

chinese_meaning: 主要的；主導的；佔優勢的
example_en: a dominant military power
example_zh: 主要軍事力量

example_en: a downward trend
example_zh: 下降的趨勢

chinese_meaning: （尤指行動）嚴厲的，猛烈的，激烈的
example_en: drastic measures
example_zh: 嚴厲的措施

example_en: One of the drawbacks of living with someone is having to share a bathroom.
example_zh: 和別人合住的缺點之一就是不得不合用洗手間。

chinese_meaning: 兩部分的;二元的;雙重的
example_en: This room has a dual purpose, serving as both a study and a dining room.
example_zh: 這個房間有兩個用途，既作書房又當飯廳。

example_en: He planned a stay of two years' duration.
example_zh: 他計劃停留兩年。

chinese_meaning: 有勇氣的，大膽的;勇於冒險的
example_en: a daring escape
example_zh: 大膽的逃亡

chinese_meaning: （尤指因計劃和組織不周而導致的）徹底失敗，一敗塗地，崩潰
example_en: The collapse of the company was described as the greatest financial debacle in US history.
example_zh: 那間公司的破產被稱為美國歷史上最大的一場金融災難。

example_en: Debris from the aircraft was scattered over a large area.
example_zh: 飛機殘駭散落在一片很大的區域。

example_en: If you calculate the result to two decimal places (= give two numbers after the decimal point, as in 3.65), that should minimize any possible errors.
example_zh: 如果將計算結果保留兩位小數，就會最大限度地減小可能的誤差。

example_en: The decree stopped short of a full declaration of independence.
example_zh: 這項法令差一點就宣佈完全獨立了。

example_en: The player had points deducted (from his score) for arguing with the referee.
example_zh: 那名運動員因與裁判發生爭執而被扣分。

chinese_meaning: （尤指很壞或很好的）事情，行為
example_en: It seems to me that a lot of evil deeds are done in the name of religion.
example_zh: 在我看來，很多壞事都是打著宗教旗幟做的。

example_en: One way of preventing further flooding would be to deepen the river bed.
example_zh: 防止洪水再次泛濫的一個辦法是深挖河床。

example_en: The demonstration is a pointless act/gesture of defiance against the government.
example_zh: 透過示威來對抗政府是一種毫無意義的行為／姿態。

example_en: a defiant attitude/gesture
example_zh: 挑釁的態度／姿態

example_en: A diet deficient in vitamin D may cause the disease rickets.
example_zh: 飲食中缺乏維他命D可導致佝僂病。

chinese_meaning: 不復存在的；死亡的；失靈的
example_en: members of a now defunct communist organization
example_zh: 目前已解散的共產主義組織的成員

example_en: Educational standards are degenerating year by year because of a lack of funds.
example_zh: 由於缺乏資金，教育水準連年下降。

chinese_meaning: 貶低;降低…的身份;侮辱…的人格
example_en: Pornography degrades women.
example_zh: 色情作品是對女性的侮辱。

chinese_meaning: （通常指年輕的）違法者;不良青少年
example_en: juvenile delinquents
example_zh: 青少年罪犯

example_en: Much has been written about the circumstances surrounding her demise.
example_zh: 關於她去世的情況已有很多文章。

example_en: The colour red is used to denote passion or danger.
example_zh: 紅色用於表示激情或危險。

example_en: The government's economic policy has been denounced on all sides.
example_zh: 政府的經濟政策受到了各方面的譴責。

chinese_meaning: 可以信賴的，可以信任的
example_en: I need someone dependable to take care of the children while I'm at work.
example_zh: 我上班的時候需要有一個可靠的人來照顧孩子們。

example_en: The painter's depictions of the horror of war won her a worldwide reputation.
example_zh: 這位畫家對戰事恐怖的描繪使她蜚聲國際。

example_en: The company is reconsidering the way in which it deploys its resources/staff.
example_zh: 詃公司在重新考慮其資源／員工的使用之道。

example_en: the deployment of technologies to address this challenge
example_zh: 為應對這個挑戰的高科技運用

chinese_meaning: 把…驅逐出境，把…遣送出境
example_en: Thousands of illegal immigrants are caught and deported every year.
example_zh: 每年都有數千名非法移民被捕並被驅逐出境。

chinese_meaning: 道德敗壞的，墮落的，惡毒的
example_en: a depraved character/mind
example_zh: 不良品質／思想

chinese_meaning: 血緣關係，家族關係;祖先;出身
example_en: She's a woman of mixed/French descent.
example_zh: 她是一個混血／法裔女人。

example_en: a descriptive essay/passage
example_zh: 描述性文章／段落

example_en: Traditionally, the president designates his or her successor.
example_zh: 按照傳統，總統要選定其接班人。

example_en: The two groups despise each other.
example_zh: 這兩個團體互相鄙視。

example_en: The money was destined for the relief of poverty, but was diverted by corrupt officials.
example_zh: 這些資金是用於救濟窮人的，卻被腐敗的官員挪用了。

chinese_meaning: 一無所有的，赤貧的，一貧如洗的
example_en: The floods left thousands of people destitute.
example_zh: 洪水使數千人一貧如洗。

example_en: the destructive power of nuclear weapons
example_zh: 核武器的殺傷力

example_en: The label became detached from your parcel.
example_zh: 標籤已經從你的包裹上掉下來了。

example_en: A suspect has been detained by the police for questioning.
example_zh: 一名嫌疑人已被員警拘留接受進一步審訊。

example_en: Concern has been expressed about the death in detention of a number of political prisoners.
example_zh: 人們對一些政治犯在關押期間死去表示關注。

example_en: These measures are designed to deter an enemy attack.
example_zh: 這些措施旨在阻止敵人的進攻。

example_en: We've seen a deterioration in relations between the countries.
example_zh: 我們看到國家之間的關係惡化。

example_en: The recent pattern of weather deviates from the norm for this time of year.
example_zh: 近來的天氣狀況與往年同期相比有些異常。

example_en: He inspired respect and devotion from his pupils.
example_zh: 他贏得了學生們的尊敬和愛戴。

example_en: The young cubs hungrily devoured the deer.
example_zh: 幼獅們貪婪地吞食著鹿肉。

example_en: disposable/reusable diapers
example_zh: 即棄／可重複使用的尿布

chinese_meaning: （一國人口向其他國家的）流散，大移居
example_en: Nearly two-fifths of Spain's foreign residents come from the Latin diaspora - mostly from Ecuador and Colombia.
example_zh: 西班牙近五分之二的外國居民來自拉丁裔僑民，其中大部分來自厄瓜多和哥倫比亞。

example_en: a military dictatorship
example_zh: 軍事獨裁統治國家

example_en: Television is a powerful means of diffusing knowledge.
example_zh: 電視是傳播知識的有力工具。

example_en: The number 345 contains three digits.
example_zh: 數字345是個三位數。

example_en: She hoped that her diligence would be noticed at work.
example_zh: 她希望她的勤奮能在單位裏得到註意。

chinese_meaning: 認真刻苦的，勤奮的，勤勞的
example_en: a diligent student
example_zh: 用功的學生

example_en: Dilute the juice (with water) before you drink it.
example_zh: 果汁先（用水）稀釋一下再喝。

example_en: I hate dining alone.
example_zh: 我不喜歡一個人吃晚飯。

example_en: The boss issued a directive about not using the fax machine.
example_zh: 老闆下令不要使用台傳真機。

example_en: She was disabled in the accident.
example_zh: 她在那次事故中致殘。

example_en: His response was one of complete disbelief.
example_zh: 他的反應是完全不相信。

example_en: Discarded food containers and bottles littered the streets.
example_zh: 街上到處都是被丟棄的食品包裝和瓶子。

example_en: I could just discern a figure in the darkness.
example_zh: 在黑暗中我只能看出一個人影。

chinese_meaning: 允許…離開;（尤指）允許…出院;（根據法庭決議）釋放
example_en: Patients were discharged from the hospital because the beds were needed by other people.
example_zh: 由於其他人需要床位，患者們便被允許出院了。

example_en: an ardent disciple of Gandhi
example_zh: 甘地忠實的追隨者

example_en: disciplinary measures/action (= punishment)
example_zh: 懲罰措施／行動

example_en: Any public disclosure of this information would be very damaging to the company.
example_zh: 公開這些資料將對公司非常不利。

example_en: Never try to fix a broken machine without disconnecting it from the electricity supply.
example_zh: 機器壞了一定要先切斷電源再去修理。

chinese_meaning: 不連貫的，斷斷續續的，零散的
example_en: These are disconnected events, of no wider significance.
example_zh: 這些都是互不相關的事件，沒有更廣泛的意義。

chinese_meaning: 使名譽受損;使受到懷疑
example_en: Evidence of links with drug dealers has discredited the mayor.
example_zh: 市長與販毒分子有瓜葛的證據使他名譽掃地。

example_en: There is some discrepancy between the two accounts.
example_zh: 這兩份帳單之間有一些出入。

example_en: These small companies now have their own discrete identity.
example_zh: 這些小公司現在都各有各的特點。

example_en: He regards the political process with disdain.
example_zh: 他對這一政治進程持鄙視的態度。

chinese_meaning: 可恥的，丟臉的，不光彩的
example_en: disgraceful behaviour/conduct
example_zh: 可恥的行為

example_en: She dismantled the washing machine to see what the problem was, but couldn't put it back together again.
example_zh: 她拆開洗衣機想看看出了甚麽問題，但是卻裝不起來了。

example_en: Two loads of cloth were dispatched to the factory on 12 December.
example_zh: 12月12日兩車布料被發到工廠。

example_en: There is a vending machine on the platform that dispenses snacks.
example_zh: 月臺上有一個出售零食的自動售貨機。

example_en: When the rain came down the crowds started to disperse.
example_zh: 雨下來時人群開始四處散開。

chinese_meaning: 迫使…離開常居地（或原位）
example_en: The blow displaced the woman's eardrum and left her partially deaf.
example_zh: 這次打擊使該婦女的耳膜移位，導致她部分失聰。

chinese_meaning: 我們首次會面時他粗暴的態度使我對他沒産生甚麽好感。
example_en: His rudeness when we first met didn't dispose me very kindlyto/towards him.
example_zh: 我們首次會面時他粗暴的態度使我對他沒産生甚麽好感。

example_en: What amazes me is her complete disregard for anyone else's opinion.
example_zh: 讓我吃驚的是，她完全無視他人的意見。

chinese_meaning: （尤指對正式建議、計劃或普遍看法的）不同意，異議
example_en: When the time came to approve the proposal, there were one or two voices of dissent.
example_zh: 在通過該項提案的時候，有一兩個人表示不同意。

example_en: political dissidents
example_zh: 持不同政見者

example_en: I tried to dissuade her from leaving.
example_zh: 我試圖勸說她不要離開。

example_en: His lessons bore me to distraction.
example_zh: 聽他講課我打不起精神來。

example_en: a film distributor
example_zh: 電影發行公司

example_en: The two groups have existed in a state of mutual distrust for centuries.
example_zh: 幾個世紀以來這兩個群體一直處於互不信任的狀態之中。

chinese_meaning: （尤指路邊或田邊用來供水、排水或劃分土地的）溝渠，壕溝

example_en: Millions of years ago, changes in the earth's climate caused animal and plant life to diversify.
example_zh: 數百萬年前，地球氣候的變化導致了動植物的多樣化。

example_en: Traffic diversions will be kept to a minimum throughout the festival.
example_zh: 在節日期間，儘量少實行交通禁行措施。

example_en: Dividends will be sent to shareholders.
example_zh: 紅利將被派發給股東。

example_en: The Vietnam war was an extremely divisive issue in the US
example_zh: 越南戰爭在美國是一個極具爭議的問題。

chinese_meaning: （尤指政治或宗教的）信條，教義，學說
example_en: Christian doctrine
example_zh: 基督教教義

example_en: He dodged to avoid the hurtling bicycle.
example_zh: 他閃身躲過了疾馳而來的腳踏車。

chinese_meaning: 註定失敗（或滅亡、毀滅）的
example_en: This is a doomed city.
example_zh: 這是一座註定要毀滅的城市。

example_en: He left the package on the doorstep.
example_zh: 他把包裹留在了門前的臺階上。

example_en: The long-dormant volcano has recently shown signs of erupting.
example_zh: 休眠了很久的火山最近出現了要噴發的跡象。

example_en: a shark's dorsal fin
example_zh: 鯊魚的背鰭

example_en: "What's the dosage?" "One spoonful three times a day."
example_zh: 「服用多大劑量?」「每次一匙，一日三次。」

chinese_meaning: 毫無疑問，毋庸置疑，肯定
example_en: They will doubtless protest, but there's nothing they can do.
example_zh: 他們肯定會提出抗議，但卻也無能爲力。

example_en: bread dough
example_zh: 麵包坯

chinese_meaning: 炸麵包圈;炸果醬麵包;甜甜圈
example_en: a jam (US jelly) doughnut
example_zh: 炸果醬麵包

example_en: drainage channels/ditches/systems
example_zh: 排水渠／溝／系統

chinese_meaning: 沈悶的，單調乏味的，令人沮喪的
example_en: a dreary little town
example_zh: 沉悶的小城

example_en: a kitchen dresser
example_zh: 櫥櫃

example_en: Water dripped down the wall.
example_zh: 水順著牆滴下來。

example_en: We heard tyres coming down the gravel driveway.
example_zh: 我們聽到輪胎沿著碎石車道行駛的聲音。

example_en: Tomorrow will be cloudy with outbreaks of rain and drizzle.
example_zh: 明天多雲，有陣雨和零星小雨。

example_en: a hair dryer
example_zh: （吹乾頭髮用的）吹風機

example_en: She was dubbed by the newspapers "the Angel of Death".
example_zh: 她被報紙稱為「死亡天使」。

example_en: Children like this used to be described as "deaf and dumb".
example_zh: 這樣的孩子過去被形容為「又聾又啞」。

example_en: The documents had been duplicated.
